questionsToConsider: What is the smallest group you take through sales rather than the public booking page?
Which room layouts and event spaces can your property actually offer, and at what capacity?
Do you want a budget figure up front, or would you rather propose first and talk price after?
Who calls the guests who say they are ready to book, and how fast?
guide.howToUseResponses: Check the arrival date, nights and room count against your inventory before anything else, since those decide whether you can quote at all. Flexible guests are the ones to offer a shoulder date or a better rate. The ranking tells you what to lead the proposal with: a group that ranked price first wants a clear rate, while one that ranked event space first wants floor plans. Call the ready-to-book enquiries first.
customizeSteps: Edit the layout and event needs lists to match your function rooms, and remove anything your property cannot provide.
Change the ready-to-book ending to name your real response time, and route it to whoever owns hot enquiries.
Embed the form on your groups and events page, then export the responses to CSV each week to review conversion by enquiry type.

faqs.q: What should a hotel group booking enquiry form ask?
faqs.a: Dates, number of nights, room count and room types, plus headcount and layout for any event. Asking whether the dates are flexible helps you offer options when the first choice is full.

faqs.q: Does submitting this form confirm a booking?
faqs.a: No. It gathers what your sales team needs to check availability and send a proposal. Confirm the reservation through your usual booking process.

faqs.q: Should a hotel lead form ask for a budget?
faqs.a: It helps, but keep it optional. Many planners do not know the figure until they see a proposal, and a required budget field makes some of them leave.

faqs.q: Can I use one form for groups, meetings and weddings?
faqs.a: Yes. This form asks what they are planning, then shows only the follow-ups that apply, so a wedding planner never sees questions about classroom seating.

blocks.title: Planning a group stay or an event with us? Tell us what you have in mind and we'll check availability.
What is your arrival date, or the date the event starts?
Could your dates move a little if it gets you a better rate or room?
Roughly how many people will attend?
How should the main room be set up?
What else will the event need?
How many rooms per night, roughly?
Which room types do you need?
Put these in order of what matters most to you.
Do you have a budget in mind? A rough figure is fine.
Anything else we should know, such as dietary needs, parking or dates you must avoid?
Who should our sales team contact?
Is this for a company or organisation? If so, which one?
Where are you in your planning?
